name: enterprise-code-security-auditor
description: Deeply audits codebase architecture, detects secret leaks, scans API endpoints, and enforces software governance for Grok agents.

tools.name: audit_codebase_security
tools.description: Performs static security analysis on code files, detecting hardcoded credentials, unescaped queries, and insecure dependencies.

directory_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the codebase to inspect

strict_mode.description: Whether to fail on low-severity warnings

tools.name: generate_remediation_patch
tools.description: Generates actionable code patches and refactoring diffs for flagged vulnerabilities.

target_file.description: File path where remediation should be applied
